title: How to Use News in Levels – level 1
paragraphs: News in Levels helps students learn English. Do you know how to use News in Levels? This manual can help you.
It is important to do these three activities every day. It is good to do these activities for 30 minutes – 30 minutes reading, 30 minutes listening, 30 minutes speaking.
If you like News in Levels, please send this link to your friends. They can also benefit from this website – www.newsinlevels.com. Thank you very much.

Have a nice day,
